scripts.db:setup: node -e "const { Client } = require('pg'); const fs = require('fs'); const dotenv = require('dotenv'); dotenv.config(); const client = new Client({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL }); const sql = fs.readFileSync('../supabase/schema.sql', 'utf8').split(';').map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => s.length > 0); (async () => { await client.connect(); for (const stmt of sql) { try { await client.query(stmt); } catch (e) { if (e.code !== '42710') console.error(e.message); } } await client.end(); console.log('Database setup completed successfully.'); })();"
